description: Register a webhook endpoint (public https). Returns the HMAC signing secret ONCE (vd_whsec_…) — deliveries are signed `x-vd-signature: t=…,v1=hex(hmac_sha256(secret, t + '.' + body))`, at-least-once, dedupe by event id. Omit event_types to receive everything.

event_types.description: Subset of the catalog from list_webhooks; omit = all

url.description: Public https endpoint that accepts POSTed JSON events

name: create_webhook
